projects.summary: Rate-setting, commercial follow-up and capacity allocation on the EASTMED and North Africa trades.

metric.label: tracked each week via Le Havre

projects.imageAlt: Container ship on the EASTMED service
projects.contexte: Embedded in the commercial team at MSC, the world's largest container carrier, on the EASTMED liner service connecting Europe to the Eastern Mediterranean and North Africa.
projects.monRole: Commercial Liner on the EASTMED scope: daily commercial follow-up, rate-setting and capacity allocation, coordinating with the ports and offices in the network.
travail: Building rate quotes and handling tenders and one-off requests, case by case and on a daily basis
Capacity allocation and commercial-flow monitoring on the EASTMED and North Africa trades

projects.summary: The interdependence of shipping lines and island nations — the cases of Madagascar and Mauritius.
projects.contexte: A research thesis examining the maritime dependence of island states through a comparative study of Madagascar and Mauritius.
projects.monRole: Author: building the research question, collecting and processing data, conducting interviews, writing and recommendations.
travail: Literature review on sea power and the logistics dependence of island states
Use of connectivity and logistics-performance data (UNCTAD and World Bank indices)
Conducting interviews with actors in the logistics chain
Recommendations for Madagascar's logistics chain
resultats: Comparative analytical grid for Madagascar and Mauritius
Recommendations for Madagascar, for Mauritius and for island states
projects.enseignement: Island states' maritime dependence plays out as much internally — port organisation, data, coordination — as externally.

thesis.subtitle: The interdependence of shipping lines and island nations — the cases of Madagascar and Mauritius
thesis.methodology: Mixed methodology: literature review, analysis of connectivity and logistics-performance data (UNCTAD Liner Shipping Connectivity Index, World Bank Logistics Performance Index) and interviews.

toc.part: Part I — Theoretical framework: sea power, dependence and logistics power
chapters: 1.1 The sea as the foundation of world trade
1.2 From states' sea power to private carriers
1.3 Defining maritime dependence: asymmetry, substitution, logistics sovereignty
1.4 Logistics capitalism and neo-colonisation: secondary frameworks

toc.part: Part II — Comparative study: Madagascar and Mauritius
chapters: 2.2 Comparative results: connectivity, performance, crises, the state's role

summary: The thesis analyses island states' maritime dependence on international logistics companies, and its influence on commercial competitiveness, economic sovereignty and negotiating capacity.
Based on a Madagascar–Mauritius comparison, it defines logistics sovereignty not as an exit from interdependence but as a state's capacity to know, measure and steer its dependence.
It proposes a national flows observatory, a total-landed-cost approach and regional maritime diversification.

projects.role: Intern — Research & Customer Studies Project Management
projects.summary: Steering and synthesising the customer studies of the Customer Relations Division, and building a cross-cutting tracking tool.

metric.label: customer studies tracked, across all fields

projects.imageAlt: Services Industriels de Genève — steering customer studies
projects.contexte: A six-month internship within the Customer Relations Division of Services Industriels de Genève (SIG), the multi-utility provider (electricity, water, gas, heat) of the Canton of Geneva. The division runs customer studies across all of the group's activities.
projects.monRole: Intern in research and customer-studies project management: making the full set of ongoing studies legible and steerable, across all fields.
travail: Designed a workboard-style tracking tool to visualise every ongoing customer study, across all fields — presented to internal clients
Wrote one-page summaries ("one-pagers") for each study to make them easier for teams to read
Contributed to more than five customer studies on varied topics: customer satisfaction, soft mobility, water
resultats: A single steering board giving an overview of all customer studies, adopted as an internal presentation support
Reusable one-page summaries that sped up teams' uptake of the studies
projects.enseignement: Making scattered information legible and actionable is worth as much as the study itself: the synthesis is a deliverable in its own right.
